name: dtwin
description: Digital Twin platform for a single commercial building — spatial hierarchy, IoT telemetry, energy simulation, 3D dashboard

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U dtwin -d dtwin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dtwin/types && npm run typecheck -w @dtwin/db && npm run typecheck -w @dtwin/ingest && npm run typecheck -w @dtwin/web
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke -w @dtwin/db && npm run smoke -w @dtwin/ingest && npm run smoke:sim && npm run smoke -w @dtwin/web
scripts.sim:install: cd apps/sim && uv venv --python 3.12 && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
